serotype_evidence.value: Reference-grade genome from FDA ARGOS BioProject PRJNA231221

curation.notes: FDA ARGOS isolate FDAARGOS_555. Serotype not in metadata - LisSero required for typing. High-quality reference genome. Source: clinical isolate.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRS4035619 && mv data/SRS4035619_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRS4035619_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.download_cmd: datasets download genome accession GCF_003812545.1 --filename data/FDAARGOS_555.zip && unzip -j data/FDAARGOS_555.zip '*.fna' -d data/ && mv data/*.fna data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype TBD. Serotype not in metadata - LisSero determines ground truth. Accept exact serotype match or grouped variants (e.g., 4b/4d/4e).
validation_instructions.mlst: ST unknown - mlst determines ground truth. All 7 loci must type successfully. Document observed ST and infer lineage.
